title: Nanocage-based {SnEr2}-organic framework for high catalytic performance in cycloaddition of CO2 with epoxides and Knoevenagel condensation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21914-21921
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02661J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xu Wang, BinBin Fan, Jing Chen, Jing Du, Dahai Pan
A dual-functional {SnEr}-MOF (TYUT-13a) with hierarchical porosity enables >98% CO2 cycloaddition conversion (4 h, 65 °C, 1 atm) and >97% Knoevenagel yield, outperforming monometallic MOFs via synergistic Lewis acid (Sn/Er) and basic (N) sites.
